Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -53.92% on a 3x leveraged ETF. SPAL is also down significantly at -33.48% and is another leveraged product. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH is also down -10.9%.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged positions while staying alert to chip sector opportunities and macro headwinds.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL: Your -53.92% loss on this 3x leveraged ETF is critical. Consider trimming or setting a tighter, more realistic stop than the default 200 to protect capital.
